guideCorrection: The first Bash parse caught a damaged Homebrew JDK path. The corrected path passed syntax checking for all three blocks.
readbackCorrections: The stock build reached exit 0 and wrote a complete build receipt and unsigned APK. The outer verifier flagged its 2,731,810-byte stdout against a 2 MiB parser limit. A separate bounded read checked the whole immutable output, installed package source, build receipt, and APK without rebuilding.
The first static readback expected sdkVersion rather than aapt2's minSdkVersion field. The corrected readback verified minSdkVersion 36 and targetSdkVersion 37 from the identical APK.
limits: The stock export builder reads its local toolchain and pinned Swift dependency mirrors. The signed recipe also uses the pinned source checkouts and local build products.
Neither newly produced APK was installed. Earlier installed tests refer to the previously recorded exact development APK.
